problem.title: Flatten Linked List with Bottom Pointers
problem.problemStatement: You are given a linked list where each node contains: next pointer bottom pointer Each bottom list is individually sorted. Flatten the entire structure into a single sorted linked list using only the bottom pointers. Return the head of the flattened list.
problem.input: A linked list with next and bottom pointers.
problem.output: The head of the flattened sorted linked list.
problem.constraints: Total number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^5]
